instruction: Visit babycenter.com and access the Sophia name details to see a list of similar names.

metadata.explanation: Task variation asking user to navigate to Sophia's name detail page on babycenter.com. The name detail pages on babycenter.com include a 'similar names' section, so navigating to Sophia's page allows users to view similar names (like Sofia, Sophie, Sofie, etc.). Uses regex pattern matching to verify navigation to the Sophia name detail page. This avoids hardcoding specific URL IDs which may not be verifiable. The evaluator checks if the URL contains the pattern 'babycenter.com/baby-names/details/sophia-' which is the standard format for name detail pages on this site.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing Chrome getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) and existing metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match). No new functions needed. Pattern matches the babycenter.com URL structure for name detail pages. The Sophia name detail page includes a 'similar names' section, which satisfies the requirement to view similar names.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies navigation to Sophia's name detail page using URL pattern matching
The getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) can successfully extract the active tab URL from accessibility tree
The metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly uses regex to match the babycenter.com URL pattern for Sophia's page

Minor limitation: The instruction mentions 'to view similar names' but the evaluator only verifies URL navigation, not page content. However, this is acceptable because the instruction can be reasonably interpreted as 'navigate to the page where similar names can be viewed' rather than 'verify similar names are displayed'

The evaluator makes an assumption that babycenter.com's Sophia detail page contains a similar names section, which is documented in metadata but not verified programmatically. This is a minor robustness concern but doesn't prevent semantic verification of the core navigation task
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding page content verification to check if similar names section actually exists on the page, making the evaluator more robust to website changes
Alternatively, simplify the instruction to 'Navigate to Sophia name detail page on babycenter.com' to match what the evaluator actually verifies
